verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents SDKs, a CLI, an MCP server, and an OpenAPI spec, but nothing about a prebuilt n8n, Zapier, or other no-code automation connector. Those developer surfaces are adjacent building blocks, not the connector itself.

support.subject: As a developer, I can connect the scraping API to no-code automation platforms like n8n or Zapier through a prebuilt connector
